original_test_intent: Validate the Type 38 Base Address as a complete QWORD whose bit 0 identifies I/O versus memory space, with correct aligned resource value for the platform interface and stability after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 38 with length/identity, parse the entire little-endian QWORD, separate bit-0 address-space indication from the aligned base, compare only with approved read-only resource/design evidence, and repeat after reboot without dereferencing the address.
manual_activity: A user supplies the expected transport/resource window and approves reboot; no physical I/O or address access is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected interface transport and full QWORD/base/window
SMBIOS version/Type 38 length and raw decoder
Read-only OS resource or design baseline including no-host-window cases
safety_requirements: Use only SMBIOS and read-only resource listings; never dereference, map, probe or write the reported address.
Preserve the full raw QWORD and separate bit 0 from the aligned base.
Do not require a host window for SSIF/no-host-window designs without an approved rule.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on resource conflict or management loss and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate record length, parse QWORD/address-space/aligned base, compare approved read-only resource/design evidence and diff pre/post reboot.
Report invalid width/alignment, transport mismatch, resource conflict or drift without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve transport, base/window/alignment and no-host-window policy plus reboot plan.
Interpret resource-listing absence or conflicts and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove the full QWORD, bit-0 semantics, aligned base or transport/resource context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 38; report handle/length, raw QWORD, bit-0 space, aligned base, approved window, read-only resource correlation and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Base Address scope, Type 38 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; active address access is explicitly excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Length-validate Type 38, parse the full QWORD and bit-0 space flag, derive aligned base, compare only read-only platform resources/design and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems publishing SMBIOS Type 38 host-interface base addresses.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, decoder/dmidecode and OS resource-source versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 38 Base Address encoding and platform host-interface resource design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full-width parsing, address-space/alignment semantics and a strict no-dereference boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncation, wrong space, misalignment and resource conflicts hidden by formatted grep.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some transports expose no host-mapped window; absence in OS resources is not failure without transport context.

project_override_considerations: A project may define I/O, memory-mapped or no-host-window transports, but must document the QWORD/space/window expectation; it cannot authorize active probing within this metadata test.
expected_evidence: Approved interface transport, QWORD/base/window/alignment and resource policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 38 with handle/length and all QWORD bytes
Decoded address-space bit, aligned base and read-only resource/design comparison
Statement that the reported address was not dereferenced/probed/written
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot QWORD diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Base Address is a defined Type 38 QWORD; expected transport/resource context is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: QWORD parsing, safe resource comparison and persistence checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete QWORD, bit-0/alignment and safe resource-window validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the no-dereference safety boundary while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats missing resource policy/reboot approval as readiness and keeps engineer verdict separate.

review_improvement: Prevents a formatted base string from passing when truncated, misinterpreted as the wrong address space or inconsistent with its transport window.
independent_technical_reasoning: All required evidence can be parsed and compared read-only; the unsafe act is dereferencing the address, which is unnecessary and prohibited.
